name: Whirlwing Stormbrood // Dynamic Soar

Flash

You may cast sorcery spells and Dragon spells as though they had flash.
blocked_sentences: Dynamic Soar -- Sorcery - Omen, {2}{G}: Put three +1/+1 counters on target creature you control. (Then shuffle this card into its owner's library.)

needs.what: the Omen half of a card as a castable second face: an alternative cast from hand at the Omen's own cost ({2}{G}) and type line (Sorcery - Omen), whose card is shuffled into its owner's library instead of going to the graveyard as it resolves. `second_face` with `second_face_zone: "hand"` is the right chassis; what is missing beside it is the shuffle-self rider, which no `card_level_rider_keys` entry provides (`exiles_itself` exiles, `tucks_itself` puts it on top/bottom without a shuffle, Adventure exiles-then-recasts).
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `second_face` covers split, Adventure and Aftermath halves and is the right shape, but every existing user leaves the card in the graveyard or exile; nothing shuffles the source into its owner's library on resolution. Writing the Omen without it leaves the card in the graveyard, a different card.

needs.what: scripts/build_card_index.py must expose the Omen half: the catalog row's layout is not in `_HALVES_LAYOUTS` or `_TWO_FACED_LAYOUTS`, so the packet shows `back_face: {}` and a front-only `oracle_text`, and the residual gate cannot see the Dynamic Soar text at all.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: Without the half in the index, an answer covering only the front (Flash, Flying, and the `cast_as_though_flash` static -- which IS expressible as two statics, one with `affects_spells: {"types": ["Sorcery"]}` and one with `affects_spells: {"subtypes": ["Dragon"]}`) would pass every gate and be counted native while the printed Omen half does nothing. Same block as Marang River Regent // Coil and Catch.

notes: The front face is fully expressible: keywords flash and flying, plus `cast_as_though_flash` statics with `affects_player: "you"` filtered to Sorcery spells and to Dragon spells. Only the Omen half is blocked.
